subject: Request for short trial buffer while FintechSy unblocks API pagination
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@fintechsy.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: FintechSy Engineering <eng@fintechsy.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Trouble with pagination during connector test — need a short trial buffer

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick onboarding call yesterday. We started the connector smoke tests overnight and ran into an unexpected pagination bug in our payments API: some pages return 500s when the page param hits certain offsets. Our engineers are on it, but it looks like a 48–72 hour fix to roll a patch and validate.

We're mid‑POC and the team is blocked from exercising the larger generation workflows (longer contexts + embeddings sweeps). Without extra tokens / extra days on the sandbox trial, we won't have a clean read on perf or cost projections.

Could Redwood provide a short buffer — either a 14‑day trial extension or a 150k token sandbox top‑up — while our engs resolve the pagination issue? We'll share the integration logs (attached) and an ETA once the fix lands.

Attachments: integration_logs.zip (log snippets, stack traces)

Appreciate any help,
Olivia
VP Product
FintechSy
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@fintechsy.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Trouble with pagination during connector test — need a short trial buffer

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear the pagination quirk is slowing you down. We're happy to help keep the POC moving.

Proposed short‑term options:
- 14‑day trial extension (no billing changes) OR
- 150k token sandbox top‑up (available immediately)

I'll kick this up to Ben for quick approval on the top‑up. If you can confirm which option you prefer and a rough patch ETA (48 vs 72h), we'll move forward. Also, please attach the SOW draft you referenced in the call so Monica can align commercial terms if we need an interim extension.

I'll aim to get an answer within the day.

—Kimberly
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 13:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Trouble with pagination during connector test — need a short trial buffer

Kimberly / Monica —

I approve a one‑time 150k token sandbox top‑up for FintechSy to unblock verification. Please proceed and mark as 'POC support — engineering unblock'. No pricing credits beyond the sandbox top‑up for now.

Kim, set expiry to 30 days but note in HubSpot that this is contingent on the pagination fix; if we don't hear back in 30 days we roll tokens back. Monica — can you also confirm whether we want to put a short addendum to the SOW for formal signoff once the POC completes?

Ben
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:46:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Trouble with pagination during connector test — need a short trial buffer

Thanks Ben —

I'll prepare a one‑page SOW addendum that records the sandbox top‑up and a mutual action plan:
- 150k token allocation, expires in 30 days unless extended by agreement
- Redwood to provide tracing support (limited) to validate integration behavior
- FintechSy to provide final signoff artifacts within 2 weeks of fix deployment

I'll draft and send the SOW addendum (DocuSign link) by EOD and cc legal if any redlines appear. Meanwhile Kimberly — I'll need the HubSpot deal ID and the exact token SKU so I can attach the credit in billing.

Monica
Senior AE, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@fintechsy.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 14:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Trouble with pagination during connector test — need a short trial buffer

Hi all —

Thanks, this is perfect. Please apply the 150k tokens and set expiry to 30 days. Our eng ETA is ~48 hours for the patch; I will confirm as soon as validation passes. I've uploaded the full logs to the shared folder and attached the SOW draft for your review.

SOW draft: SOW-draft.pdf (attached)
Shared logs: https://drive.company/fintechsy/integration_logs

Appreciate the fast turnaround — this keeps us live for the next phase of evaluation.

Best,
Olivia
VP Product
FintechSy
